messages:
tara: Noticed a clear recurring pattern in the last 5 postmortems: KV eviction bursts -> token-service P95 spikes -> autoscaler oscillation. Spinning up this thread to agree owners, timelines, and concrete runbook/playbook edits.

maria: Agree. We need a short 'first responder' checklist + exact commands so on-call can act fast. Also want an escalation ladder with SLO thresholds.

sam: I can draft the one-liner checklist and escalation ladder. Suggest thresholds: eviction_rate >2% for 3m = notify, >5% for 5m = page.

anya: I'll take the runbook edits (add Quick Triage, Mitigations, Recovery sections). Creating ticket RW-4810. Target PR by 2026-04-02.

devon: Putting operator commands we used in the last incident so they can be copy-pasted:
```
# eviction and mem checks
curl -s "https://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=kv_cache_eviction_rate%5B1m%5D"
# lower batch size on pool 'serve-main'
redwoodctl deploy --pool serve-main --set batch_size=5
# pin model to low-mem variant
redwoodctl route set --model product-model --variant lowmem-v2 --note "postmortem-RW-4810"
# rollback canary if needed
redwoodctl rollout rollback --model product-model --to-version stable
```

maria: Playbook note: require annotating any temporary routing/model-pin changes with `postmortem-<ticket>` tag for telemetry correlation and safe revert. Add that to playbook.

sam: I'll add a short owner matrix at the top of the runbook: who pins variant (SRE oncall), who changes routing (Platform eng), who handles capacity/commit (Infra eng).

anya: Taking ownership of runbook edits and linking the operator commands and owner matrix. RW-4810 assigned to @anya, due 2026-04-02.

dash-bot: DashBot: alert rule created draft for `kv_cache_eviction_rate` and `token_latency_p95` with suppression window=3m.

maria: Action items recap:
- anya: runbook + playbook edits (RW-4810)  due 2026-04-02
- sam: one-line triage + escalation ladder + owner matrix  due 2026-03-30
- devon: ops snippet doc with `redwoodctl` examples  due EOD today
- dash-bot: alert draft + suppression rule  ETA: 48h

tara: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after RW-4810 PR lands and after alerts are live. If anyone hits blockers, escalate to infra-eng lead. :white_check_mark:
